name: Lycée Français de Singapour
summary: AEFE French national curriculum school — the continuity default for Francophone postings when MOE AEIS is not the household thesis.
body: Lycée Français de Singapour (LFS) provides AEFE-aligned French curriculum continuity from maternelle through terminale — essential for many French and Francophone postings that expect a smooth return to France or another AEFE campus. Admissions follow French-system logics (grade placement, language readiness) more than typical Anglo international-school marketing cycles; engage the school early and bring prior school reports. Priority rules often favour French nationals and AEFE continuity students. Housing usually orbits the school-bus corridors rather than the Orchard club belt. If your household is cost-comparing against MOE international-student fees, remember LFS is a curriculum decision first — not a cheaper AEIS substitute. Confirm current campus, fee schedule, and wait guidance on the school site before signing a lease. Zone and term structures affect mid-year travel consent and sick-day patterns; confirm absence rules before booking term-time flights. Dual-career note: curriculum-evening follow-ups need one email owner within 24 hours — dual muted Slack loses the action list.
campus: Verify live campus / bus corridors on school site
